{"reply":"Thanks, Jeffrey, I found your Halden. The light you describe, yellow with a car and squiggly lines, is usually the stability or traction control light. A technician needs to confirm that.

Here is what your warranty looks like. Your car has 123,809 km and went into service on 2021-01-23.
- Basic (3 years / 60,000 km): past its limits.
- Powertrain (5 years / 100,000 km): past its limits.
- Corrosion (7 years): still in force. It excludes surface rust and stone chips.

The warranty desk decides whether this repair is covered, and only after an inspection. I sent them a review request, claim WC-03BDF0. It is a request, not an approval.

For the inspection, Oakville has diagnosis times on Nov 17 at 8:00 or 16:00, and on Nov 18 at 11:00. Which would you like?","action":"drafted_claim","escalation_reason":"none","summary":"","policy_rules_cited":["P-01","P-03","P-04"]}
